headers.name: Subject
headers.value: Re: For Ilknur Icke — OpenMath Tissue Busy Beaver review

html:
Thank you Alejandro for reaching out.

Unfortunately I was not able to make it to the hackhathon in person last weekend. 

My interest in the topic was from a computational biology angle and I am not an expert on the formal proofs for the busy beaver problem. My aim was just to explore connections and this is really not the focus of my work. 

Having said that if there are other colleagues who are interested or working on this specific biology connection. I would be happy to explore further 

Best wishes
Ilknur




On Oct 2, 2026 5:58 PM, Alejandro Zarzuelo <[REDACTED CONTACT]> wrote:
Hi Ilknur, I found Tissue Busy Beaver; are you submitting a formal mathematical result from it to OpenMath?
If so, please share the repository, exact model/theorem, proof or certificate, paper, reproduction steps and submission reference before the cutoff.
Please distinguish the toy-model result from biological validation, and let me know what is still unfinished or blocked.
